question: If I order a toilet today to a California address, how many days will delivery take? And can an opened toilet be returned, and is there any fee?
answer: For a California address, standard delivery is estimated at 7–10 business days after order processing, and processing usually takes 2–3 business days (Monday–Friday). Dates can vary; the store’s information also notes shipping lead times may extend to 3–5 days due to freight delays. An opened toilet may be returnable only if it is in its original packaging and has no physical damage or missing parts; returns must be requested within 30 days of purchase, with an RMA, and you pay return shipping. A 25% restocking fee applies per item.
